For,Ⓒprep.Ⓓ(On account of) ex. by instr. or abl.; arTe-rTaM, hetunA, hetoH, kfte, kAraRAt, nimittAt, nimittaM, in comp.; ‘for his deliverance’ mokzanimittaM, muktihetoH, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 (Purpose) by dat. or by arTaM-arTe in comp.
Ⓑ
 3 (For the sake of) arTaM, kfte (with gen.) or by dat.
Ⓑ
 4 (In exchange for) prati, sTAne, vinima-yena; tileByaH pratiyacCati mAzAn, or tila-vinimayena &c.
Ⓑ
 5 (Considering) apekzya, pratIkzya, Alocya, iti kftvA, apekzayA in comp.
Ⓑ
 6 (Towards) prati, uddiSya, (with acc.); saMmuKaM, aBimuKaM, in comp.
Ⓑ
 7 (Regarding) tAvat, uddiSya; kfte; ‘f(or) myself, rest secure’ madvizaye tAvadvItaciMto Bava, mAmuddiSya na ciMtA kAryA.
Ⓑ
 8 (Showing price) by instr.; trirUpakeRa krItaH ‘bought f(or) 3 Rs.’.
Ⓑ
 9 (Duration) by acc.; ‘for 10 days’ daSadivasaM; ‘f(or) how many years’ kiyaMti varzARi; oft. by yAvat or paryaMtaM, A with abl.; ‘f(or) life’ yAvajjIvaM, AjIvitAMtAt.
Ⓑ
 10 (on the side of) pakze; ‘they are f(or) war’ vigrahamanumodaMte, vigrahamupadiSaMti.
Ⓑ
 11 (As if) vat or iva.
Ⓑ
 12 (According to) yaTA, anurUpaM, anusAreRa, in comp.; ‘f(or) all’ ex. by anAdftya (with acc.) or loc. abs. ‘f(or) all his wealth’ vidyamAnepi mahAkoSe, mahAkoSamanAdftya; ‘f(or) a long time’ ciraM, cirakAlaM, cirAya; ‘out of love f(or) me’ madgataprItyA; ‘f(or) the most part’ BUyizWa in comp., prAyaH, prAyeRa; ‘f(or) once’ sakfdeva.
Ⓔconj.Ⓓhi (not at beginning of assertions); yataH, yasmAtkAraRAt, yat, yasmAt, iti hetoH, anena hetunA.

Ⓑ

Ⓑ
